tweaks.name: Status bar carrier name
tweaks.description: Replace the carrier text shown next to the signal bars with a custom name, single or dual SIM.
tweaks.rollback: Write the reset record. SpringBoard then deletes its own archive, which needs no delete primitive.

tweaks.name: Reset carrier name to native
tweaks.description: Restore whatever the SIM actually reports by writing the empty StatusBarOverrides record.
tweaks.rollback: Nothing to undo; this is itself the restore path.

tweaks.name: Custom battery icon
tweaks.unsupported_reason: iOS 27's SystemStatusUI override record has no field for the battery glyph. The legacy statusBarOverrides engine that did support it is gated behind /var/preferences/FeatureFlags/Settings.plist, which is outside AirLift's write scope. 13 documented upstream attempts reached the same wall.

tweaks.name: Force battery percentage
tweaks.description: Always show the numeric battery percentage next to the icon.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: This is a per-device Accessibility setting stored in com.apple.springboard preferences; there is no writable file that exposes it and iOS ignores any value outside the real Accessibility store.

tweaks.name: Custom time format / 24-hour
tweaks.description: Force 24-hour time or a custom date string in the status bar.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Time format lives in the user's locale settings (.GlobalPreferences under Managed Preferences), which is outside AirLift's write scope.

tweaks.name: Hide Wi-Fi / cellular indicators
tweaks.description: Remove the Wi-Fi, cellular or VPN glyphs from the status bar.
tweaks.unsupported_reason: Indicator visibility is decided inside SystemStatusUI from system status; no user-domain file exposes it.

tweaks.name: Minimal status bar (carrier only)
tweaks.description: Reduce the iOS 27 status bar to just the carrier name.
